steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. I can't find any difference between the two listings.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Colour and box contents | Graphite, case, USB-C and 3.5 mm cables | Same |

The two pages show an identical rating and review count. That may mean the reviews belong to the product and not to the seller. If so, they tell you nothing about how reliable each seller is.

Some things the pages don't show could still matter:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's own ratings or reviews somewhere else, if you can.
- **Authenticity:** Neither page says whether the seller is an authorized Quellwyn retailer. That could affect whether the warranty is honored.
- **Return details:** Check whether either seller charges a restocking fee. Neither page mentions one.

If those checks turn up nothing, pick either one. If you want a tiebreaker, choose the seller you can confirm is an authorized retailer or has better independent feedback.
